# Domain schema treemap/v0

A containment forest (at most one parent each, no cycles) whose leaves carry a nonnegative `data.value`. The engine checks the forest and that leaves are weighted. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/treemap/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/treemap/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/treemap/v0.json).

An extraction in this schema is an [extraction](extraction.md) whose `schema` is `treemap/v0`; the extraction schema applies this one
to it.

## Typed data

The engine checks every typed field, and reports a violation at its path. Other `data` fields are open JSON.

### Entities

| Kind | Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Every kind | `data.value` | number |  | The entity's weight. Required on leaves (entities that contain nothing); optional on containers. At least 0. |
